# VOAD Architecture & Interiors

> VOAD is an architecture and interior design studio based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India. Led by Ar. Vivek Bosmiya, the studio specialises in bespoke residential architecture, luxury interior design, heritage restoration, commercial spaces, and turnkey project delivery across Gujarat and India. Nine years of practice, 70+ completed projects.

## Services

- **Residential Architecture**: Bespoke homes, bungalows, villas, and farmhouses designed for the Gujarat climate and each family's lifestyle.
- **Interior Design**: Refined luxury interiors for residences, kitchens, suites, and premium hospitality environments.
- **Commercial & Office Design**: Workspaces and corporate offices designed to support productivity and reflect brand identity.
- **Heritage Designs**: Sympathetic restoration and adaptive reuse of historic havelis and heritage buildings across Gujarat.
- **Renovation & Remodelling**: Transforming existing spaces through improved layouts, upgraded materials, and refined finishes.
- **Turnkey Solutions**: Complete project execution from concept development through construction supervision to final handover.

## About the Studio

- **Principal Architect**: Ar. Vivek Bosmiya, Principal Architect and Interior Designer
- **Location**: Rajkot, Gujarat, India
- **Years of Practice**: 9 years
- **Projects Completed**: 70+
- **Service Area**: Rajkot, Gujarat, and across India
- **Studio Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 am to 7:00 pm IST

## Notable Projects

- Prasoonbhai Residence, Rajkot (2025) - Luxury residential interior
- Nishitbhai Gajera Residence, Rajkot (2025) - Contemporary residential interior
- Niravbhai Residence, Mumbai (2026) - Compact luxury apartment design
- Vraj Vilas Haveli, Jetpur (2026) - Heritage haveli with Vaishnav spiritual complex
- Ravi Exports Corporate Headquarters, Rajkot (2026) - Commercial office design
- Bantesh Udhyog Corporate Office, Jetpur (2025) - Commercial office interior

## Design Philosophy

VOAD believes great design goes beyond aesthetics. It is about creating environments that enhance how people live, work, and connect. The studio stays involved from the first sketch through to handover, ensuring one point of accountability and a result that matches what the client imagined.
